title: Compare
description: Put two subjects side by side and explore differences in collected data.
searchHint: Include a server number with the name to narrow your search.
refine: Showing up to 20 matches. Refine your search.
loading: Loading the latest snapshot. The first request may take a while.
invalid: Some saved subjects are absent from the latest data. Select them again.
differenceHint: Percentages use B as the baseline.
chooseHint: Select two subjects of the same type to see their metrics and differences.
notice: Collected samples do not represent the full server population or predict battle outcomes. Observation times may differ. Missing power is not zero; averages include only players with collected power. Shared links open the latest available data.
scopeHint: Ranked by collected power per server; UID breaks ties. Missing power is excluded from Top groups. Smaller samples use available players. Power, level and alliance counts below reflect this scope.
kartzHint: Kartz uses the whole server ranking for the selected period, independent of the Top scope. Absence from rankings does not mean non-participation. Lower best rank is better.
kartzEmpty: No Kartz records for this period.

advantage.powerHint: Compares power in the selected scope. The bar shows each side’s share of combined power.
advantage.limited: Incomplete or undersized samples. Only collected power is compared.
advantage.kartzHint: Counts leads across three metrics: Top100 players, average round and alliance score.
advantage.notice: Based on collected records, not battle win probability. Population, alliance counts and power concentration are contextual, not scored.
